hook: Summing over all subspaces of a vector space takes N log N time, like the classic subset transform.
summary: Summing values over all subspaces of a finite-field vector space was thought to need slower lattice methods. The authors give a time algorithm proportional to N log N for N subspaces, with uses in Grassmann graph computations and graph coloring. Tests show speedups of up to 18 times on some tasks, with Lean 4 proofs of the identities. The gains are for these structured problems only.
title: A Fast Algorithm for Subspace Convolution
